title: Basque Sweet Empanadas
description: Flaky pastry pockets filled with a sweet and sticky mixture of raisins and dark brown sugar, perfect for a sweet treat.

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: use high-quality, unbleached flour for best results

ingredients.name: granulated sugar
ingredients.notes: white sugar is fine, but dark brown sugar is traditional in Basque pastries

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.notes: softened butter is easier to work with

ingredients.name: large egg
ingredients.notes: beaten egg helps the pastry come together

ingredients.name: active dry yeast
ingredients.notes: use instant yeast if you prefer

ingredients.name: warm milk
ingredients.notes: warm milk helps the yeast activate

ingredients.name: confectioners sugar
ingredients.notes: for dusting the pastries before baking

ingredients.name: raisins
ingredients.notes: dark or golden raisins work well in this recipe

ingredients.name: vanilla extract
ingredients.notes: use high-quality vanilla extract for the best flavor

instructions: Combine flour, granulated sugar, and yeast in a large mixing bowl.
Add the softened butter and use a pastry blender or your fingers to work it into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg, warm milk, and vanilla extract. Add this mixture to the flour mixture and stir until a shaggy dough forms.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead for 5-7 minutes, until the dough becomes smooth and elastic.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and let it rest for 1 hour, or until it has doubled in size.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball of dough into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Place a tablespoon or two of the raisin mixture in the center of each circle of dough.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape, and press the edges together to seal the pastry.
Use a fork to crimp the edges of the pastry and create a decorative border.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch of space between each pastry.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with a little bit of water, then sprinkle with confectioners sugar.
Air-fry the empanadas at 375°F (190°C) for 10-12 minutes, or until they are golden brown and puffed up.
Let the empanadas cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve warm, dust with confectioners sugar if desired
